readme:
# Google Keyword Overview API

Get search volume, CPC, competition, search intent, monthly trend and SERP info for up to 100 Google keywords by location and language.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/dataforseo/v3/dataforseo_labs/google/keyword_overview/live" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"keywords": ["openai api"], "location_code": 2840, "language_code": "en"}'
```

## Parameters

The body is passed through to DataForSEO. See the [official documentation](https://docs.dataforseo.com/v3/dataforseo_labs/google/keyword_overview/live/) for every field.

## Pricing

Flat price per call. One task per request; `limit` is capped at 100 and input lists (`keywords`, `targets`, `asins`, `app_ids` ...) accept at most 100 items. Failed calls are not charged.
